description: This file is a shell script containing a set of automated test cases for git-related operations, especially focusing on handling untracked files during git reset, checkout, rebase, stash, and am commands.

methods.name: test_setup_reset
methods.description: Initializes a git repository with branches 'stable' and 'work', makes commits, and switches branches.

methods.name: test_setup_checkout_m
methods.description: Sets up a git repository for testing 'git checkout -m' with tracked and untracked files.

methods.name: test_setup_sequencing
methods.description: Prepares a git repository with multiple commits, branches, and changes for testing rebase and related commands.
